intent: Consolidate image-volume tools delivery for the beta
Isolate archive credentials in image-volume delivery

name: Image-volume archive fetch
role: Mounts tools as an image volume and selects an isolated fetch init container when a pull secret is configured.
conditions: Without a pull secret the application launcher fetches inline; with one only the fetch init container mounts registry credentials and the application mounts the cache read-only.

name: Offline injector restoration
role: Records and validates the managed init container and mounts before restoring a workload.
conditions: The recorded managed init containers distinguish inline image-volume delivery from secret-backed image-volume delivery, including on reinjection.

subject: Image-volume support
why: API version alone does not prove that the feature gate and every scheduled node runtime support mounting image volumes.

title: Use an isolated fetch init container for pull secrets
why: The application can consume the archive without receiving the registry secret.
alternative: Mount the secret for the inline application fetch — rejected: application code could read the credential.

intent: Make cluster support explicit and exercise delivery modes

name: Image-volume compatibility guidance
role: Keeps the compatible init-container mode as the default and tells operators to verify image-volume support before opting in.
conditions: Offline rendering cannot establish the feature gate or runtime capability on all eligible nodes. Kubernetes 1.33–1.34 disable the gate by default, 1.35 enables it, and 1.36 makes it stable.

name: Delivery-mode end-to-end coverage
role: Runs chart and injector scenarios in both delivery modes against a pinned kind node image.
conditions: The secret-backed injector scenario checks isolated mounts and cache use with an anonymous registry; it does not verify private-registry authentication.

title: Keep image-volume delivery opt-in with explicit support guidance
why: A version check or offline renderer cannot establish feature-gate and runtime support on all eligible nodes.
alternative: Default to image-volume based on Kubernetes version — rejected: some clusters or nodes cannot mount the volume and the pod would not start.
